context: Kenji & Yuki and Daichi & Mei meet for dinner — work colleagues become couples-friends.
purpose: two-couple dinner — workplace bonds extending into shared social life

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 今夜、こうやって集まれて、ほんま嬉しいわ。
lines.en: Tonight, being together like this — it really makes me happy.
lines.style: Kansai lilt and warmth. Big open smile in the voice. Generous, genuine. The joy of inclusion unmistakable. Spreads easily to everyone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 私もすごく楽しみにしてた。
lines.en: I was really looking forward to it.
lines.style: Soft opening. Quiet sincerity underneath. Gentle pace. A small, real smile audible—not performed. The words settle like she means each one.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: こちらこそ。佐藤さんと、ずっと話してたんですよ。
lines.en: Same here. Sato-san and I have been talking about it for a while.
lines.style: Warm, easy agreement. Light emphasis on 'talking'—conspiratorial, but genuinely glad. Even tone, steady. Reliable company in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: うん、お二人にお会いするの、初めてで。
lines.en: Yes, this is my first time meeting you both.
lines.style: Gentle, almost tentative openness. A slight lilt up on 'both'—the newness is there but it's welcome. Soft, genuine interest threading through.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ゆきさんのこと、達也からよく聞いてました。
lines.en: Daichi's told me a lot about you, Yuki-san.
lines.style: Light, warm bridge-building. Not testing—offering connection. Natural pace, thoughtful. The kindness in listening to someone else's stories audible in how she says it.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 良いことばっかりやで、安心して。
lines.en: Only good things, so don't worry!
lines.style: Playful Kansai brightness. A laugh underneath. Teasing affection—making sure everyone knows he's not serious. Open, generous, impossible to doubt.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ふふ、嬉しい。共通の知り合いがいるって、いいですね。
lines.en: That makes me happy. It's nice having a mutual friend.
lines.style: A small laugh—surprised and pleased. Thoughtful beat on 'mutual'—she's registering the lightness of connection. Warm exhale trailing the sentence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 同じ職場って、話題も尽きませんしね。
lines.en: Same office—we'll never run out of things to talk about.
lines.style: Understated humor. Light, knowing tone. Not rushed. The comfort of shared experience resting in his voice without needing to explain it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: デザインの仕事、田中さんも詳しいんですか？
lines.en: Do you work in design too, Tanaka-san?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity. Slight lean-in quality in the voice. Warm, careful interest—she's asking because she wants to know. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 少しだけ。最近、芸術にも興味出てきまして。
lines.en: A little bit. I've actually been getting into art lately.
lines.style: Modest, but there's real interest underneath. Slight warmth on 'lately'—like he's admitting something small but genuine. Thoughtful, inviting follow-up.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ええやん！次、皆で美術館行こか。
lines.en: That's great! Next time, let's all go to the museum together.
lines.style: Enthusiasm and generosity in one breath. Kansai warmth. Quick idea-to-action energy. Inclusive, assuming everyone wants in. The door opening wider.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 行きたい！それは楽しい計画ね。
lines.en: I'd love to! That sounds like fun.
lines.style: Quick, genuine enthusiasm. Slight rise in energy from her baseline. The idea of 'all together' lands warmly. Real eagerness, not performing it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 皆で過ごす時間って、本当に幸せ。
lines.en: Moments like this with everyone—that's what happiness really is.
lines.style: Slower, more reflective than before. Tender certainty. Quiet voice, but weighted. A pause held at the end. She's saying something true she doesn't say often.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Energy gathering. Kansai swing bright and clear. A moment of transition—moving from talk to ritual. The invitation is in every syllable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 乾杯。これからの友情に。
lines.en: Cheers. To friendship ahead of us.
lines.style: Sincere, formal in the good way. A beat of weight on 'friendship'—it matters. Not rehearsed. Warm, direct eye-contact level steady. The toast lands true.
